title: Adversarial Decoys: Misdirecting Attention-Based Defenses in ViT
abstract: arXiv:2607.07922v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) remain vulnerable to localized adversarial attacks, e.g., adversarial patches, while recent test-time defenses mitigate them by suppressing image tokens with abnormally high attention scores. These defenses exploit a strong coupling between attention and adversarial effectiveness: adversarial tokens often need to attract substantial attention to influence the prediction. We introduce adversarial decoys, image patches optimized to redirect attention, and therefore related defenses, towards selected target tokens. Rather than jointly optimizing misclassifications and defense evasion, our approach decouples the two objectives: the original adversarial region induces the incorrect prediction, while a separate decoy manipulates the attention ranking used by the defense. translated_title: 对抗性诱饵：误导视觉Transformer中基于注意力的防御
translated_abstract: 视觉Transformer（ViT）仍然容易受到局部对抗性攻击（例如对抗性补丁）的影响，而近期的测试时防御方法通过抑制注意力分数异常高的图像token来缓解这些攻击。这些防御利用了注意力与对抗有效性之间的强耦合关系：对抗性token通常需要吸引大量注意力才能影响预测结果。我们引入了对抗性诱饵（adversarial decoys），即经过优化的图像补丁，可将注意力（进而将相关防御机制）重定向至选定的目标token。与联合优化误分类和防御规避不同，我们的方法将这两个目标解耦：原始对抗区域负责诱导错误预测，而单独的诱饵则操纵防御机制所依赖的注意力排序。逐层目标函数增加目标token的注意力，并使这些token的注意力排名高于其他相互竞争的非目标token。由于诱饵优化（原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“对抗性诱饵”技术，通过优化图像补丁将注意力重定向至选定目标token，从而误导ViT中基于注意力的对抗防御机制，实现对抗攻击与防御规避两个目标的解耦。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "adversarial decoys"—image patches optimized to redirect attention towards selected target tokens—thereby misdirecting attention-based defenses in ViTs by decoupling the objectives of misclassification and defense evasion.
